title: The Sunken Temple
author: Marisol Vance
description: Dive into flooded ruins in search of treasure - or just a way out.

sections.text: You dive into the flooded ruins of an ancient temple, air tank hissing.

options.description: Follow the current down a side tunnel

sections.text: The glowing chamber holds a stone altar humming with energy.
The tunnel narrows, but you spot an air pocket ahead.

consequence.text: Your air tank snags on coral, tearing a gash in your side.

sections.text: The altar responds to your touch and a hidden door slides open, revealing a treasure vault.
You find an inscription revealing a way to safely deactivate the altar's wards.
You surface into a small air-filled cavern with an old diver's ladder.

options.description: Climb the ladder to the surface

sections.text: You find a second, smaller chamber lit by bioluminescent algae.
You emerge with the temple's treasure, legendary among divers for generations.
You climb out into daylight, alive but empty-handed. A quieter kind of victory.
The algae chamber has a narrow shaft leading further up.
You surface far from where you started, exhausted but alive, with strange photographs of the ruins.
